items.title: HerCafe matcha cart at Overland Park Farmers Market (holiday market)
items.venue: Overland Park Farmers Market, Clock Tower Landing
items.address: 7950 Santa Fe St, Overland Park, KS 66204
items.description: HerCafe is Kansas City's first mobile matcha cart, hand-whisking drinks with in-house syrups and cold foams. Its site lists the Overland Park Farmers Market as its pop-up location every Saturday. The market runs holiday Saturdays Dec 5, 12 and 19.
items.notes: weekly schedule from https://hercafekc.com (Overland Park Farmers Market, 8am-12pm, every Saturday); hours and address from https://www.visitoverlandpark.com/things-to-do/attractions/overland-park-farmers-market/ (Saturdays Dec 5-19, 8am-12pm, Clock Tower Landing, 7950 Santa Fe St)
